rows.title_full: AN ACT TAXING PERSONS ENGAGED IN PHILIPPINE OFFSHORE GAMING OPERATIONS AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 25 AND ADDING A NEW SECTION 150-C OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Taxing Persons Engaged In Philippine Offshore Gaming Operations
rows.abstract:
Seeks to impose tax on alien individual who is a permanent resident of a foreign country and who is employed and assigned in the Philippines by an offshore gaming licensee equivalent to  twenty-five percent (25%) of the salaries, wages, annuities, compensation, remuneration and other emoluments, such as honoraria and allowances received from such licensee.

Imposes a tax equivalent to five percent (5%)  based on the gross revenue or receipts derived from gaming operations and similar related activities of all offshore gaming licensees.

rows.author: I073
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE REGISTRATION OF SUBSCRIBER IDENTITY MODULE CARDS
rows.title_short: Requiring The Registration Of Subscriber Identity Module Cards
rows.abstract:
Mandates every Public Telecommunication Entity (PTE) or direct seller to require SIM card subscribers to present a valid identification with photo and to accomplish and sign a control-numbered registration form with their full name, date of birth, gender, and address and the assigned cell phone number of SIM cards and its serial number.
States that any information in the SIM card registration shall be treated as absolute confidential, provided that under Section 12(e) of RA 10173, otherwise known as the “Data Privacy Act of 2012”, the PTE shall be required to disclose the full name and address contained in the SIM card registration, upon a duly issued subpoena or order of a court upon finding of probable cause, or upon written request from a law enforcement agency in relation to an on-going investigation, that a particular number is used in the commission of a crime or that it was used as a means to commit an unlawful act.
Requires all PTEs to maintain a SIM Card Register of their subscribers and all existing mobile phone subscribers to register with their respective PTE within 180 days with an extension period of no longer than 120 days upon valid request to the DICT.
rows.status: Vetoed by the President on 2022-04-14
rows.remarks: Withdrawal letter of Rep. Castro (F.L.) dated 2021-12-01 received on even date.
